digest.component_or_area: rebar plan vocabulary and criteria framework
propositions: The rebar plan vocabulary uses two separate headings—Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria—for one semantic concept, with gates pooling both under a single bar with no divergent treatment.
Success Criteria headings use plain bullets instead of checkboxes, causing their items to evade the P1 _count_ac_items floor count, the operator-attested tag mechanism, and individual checkability.

Collapsing Success Criteria into Acceptance Criteria across 108 stored tickets and all detector regexes, prompts, routing indices, and documentation would tighten the gate and eliminate vestigial vocabulary.

The migration is now affordable because ADR 0053 grandfathering (merged as 095c4afef) retroactively validates registry drift, removing the 632-ticket invalidation barrier from prior renaming attempts.

Store migration is complete: 106 tickets migrated, zero SC headings remain, three live files (plan_review_T2.md, plan_review_verifier.md, verify_models.py) retain SC vocabulary for unrelated concepts and must be excluded.
